arguments.sql: SELECT 1.0 * COUNT(f.transaction_id) / COUNT(*) AS labelled_fraction FROM transactions t LEFT JOIN fraud_labels f ON f.transaction_id = CAST(t.id AS TEXT)
arguments.explanation: Returns the share of all transactions that have a row in fraud_labels, as a fraction between 0 and 1. It counts labelled transactions, not fraud.
assumptions: 'Have a fraud label' means a matching row exists in fraud_labels, whatever its is_fraud value.
All transactions are counted, from 2019-01-01 to 2019-10-31, with no other filter.
